jobs.title: Software Engineer - Platform Observability and Intelligence
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: 10/05/2026

Anticipated Posting Close Date*: 12/05/2026

Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Software Engineer

We are looking for a full-stack software engineer to join Fastly’s Platform Observability and Intelligence (POI) team.

The POI Team Is Responsible For

Fastly's internal observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and more), spanning cloud infrastructure and physical hardware.
Fastly's internal developer portal, built on Backstage.
An internal set of tools and data pipelines that synthesize network and financial data to provide insights into network costs, capacity planning, and related business concerns.

We are specifically looking for someone to contribute to the first two items on this list, though you will work across all of our software.

This is a generalist, mid-level position, ideal for someone with a few years of experience who is seeking to grow their career. We are looking for an engineer who is curious, proactive, and eager to grow into an impactful role. You will work broadly and deeply, contribute meaningfully to projects that affect how Fastly engineers understand and operate their services, and build toward owning larger pieces of work over time.

What You'll Do

Design, build and maintain software and platform capabilities that power Fastly’s internal observability function and developer experience
Contribute to the development of our internal developer portal, helping engineering teams discover services, documentation, and operational tooling all in one place
Work with your team to break down project requirements into concrete tasks, and take ownership of your assigned work through to completion
Debug and resolve issues across the software stack, from datacenter hardware to the browser, often spanning multiple services and data sources
Communicate clearly about the status of your work and any problems you encounter. Write useful updates, ask good questions, and raise issues early rather than at the deadline
Collaborate with other engineers on the team. Provide thoughtful code review and share context and knowledge.
Participate constructively in team planning and retrospectives
Participate in on-call rotation as required, and respond to incidents within the team's SLA while on-call.

Technical Skills

What We're Looking For:

2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver quality work on reasonably well-defined projects with limited oversight
Experience in a statically typed, modern back-end language (Go, Java, Rust, etc.)
Experience in modern front-end frameworks (React, etc.), or a willingness to dive in and become proficient
Experience with SQL and database-driven applications
Experience working with Linux systems and the shell
Experience working with distributed systems or cloud-based services, and an interest in developing deeper expertise in operating and debugging them
Comfort with large and unfamiliar codebases: jumping into a system you didn't build, figuring out the context, and contributing with confidence. Our stack is broad, and you will regularly work in code you haven't seen before, including code written at Fastly and open-source codebases.
Strong debugging skills: forming hypotheses and narrowing down causes methodically. You’re willing to step outside your primary area of expertise to get to the bottom of something.

Ways Of Working

Clear, thoughtful writing and communication. You understand that a precise Slack message, a well-written pull request description, or a clear explanation to a teammate is just as important as the code itself.
A service mindset. The people who use our tools depend on them to do their jobs. You care about their experience, you're approachable when they have questions, and you follow through and close the communication loop
A proactive disposition. You take ownership of your responsibilities. When you finish a task, you look for the next useful thing. When you see something that could be better, you say so.
Comfort working within lightweight agile processes. You participate constructively in planning and retrospectives, and you see team rituals as tools for coordination, productivity, and collaboration.
A desire to grow in your skills, knowledge, and scope. Enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

Backstage or other internal developer portal frameworks, open-source software in general
Enterprise-scale observability systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, ELK, or similar
Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Chef)
Data science and data engineering, capacity planning, cost modeling, or FinOps practices
Network protocols and infrastructure, datacenter infrastructure, physical server administration
Training, teaching, or developing documentation and educational materials for internal tools

Work Hours

This position will require you to be available during core business hours. It may also require occasional nights and weekends as necessary to support any on-call coverage.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

This position is open to Hybrid And Remote Work Locations.

The preferred locations for this position are:

San Francisco, CA
New York, NY

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.

There is a strong preference for Hybrid near a local office. However, we may be willing to consider remote candidates within the US.

This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

SF / LA Fair Chance Ordinance Statement

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Salary

The estimated salary range for this position is $155,370 to $186,444.

Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs.

Benefits

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 12 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days.

Why Fastly?

We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.
We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.
We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply!
A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.

All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers . We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @ fastly.com or @ recruiting.fastly.com email address.

Our employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. jobs.description:
About AngelList

Private markets are the new public markets. The most important companies of this era are private, and almost no one can own them. What's missing is the financial system public markets spent a century building: exchanges, custodians, brokers, and ways for ordinary people to buy in. Private markets, now $28T, never had the equivalent. AngelList is building it.

The last decade of structural innovation in venture happened here: syndicates, SPVs at scale, Rolling Funds, scout programs. Today we have $200B+ in assets and 30,000+ startups funded on our platform. The rest of private markets is next. Funds is the software and services behind private funds, Nova is the banking network, Meridian is the wealth platform for accredited investors, and USVC is the brand behind a registered fund that lets anyone invest in venture.

Working here means an unusual amount of agency on a problem that matters. Titles are closer to suggestions, and there are about 200 of us building what private markets never had. Come build it with us.

About The Role

Nova is building the banking and payments network for private markets. Fund managers, fund administrators, and investors use our software to manage subscriptions, capital calls, and distributions. Nova currently supports $1.2B+ in deposits, $100M+ in weekly transfers across six bank integrations, and ~150k verified investors. These transactions are among the highest-stakes moments in private markets. Customers move real money and expect every detail to be correct. Consistent accuracy is how Nova earns and keeps the trust of GPs and LPs.

If you're a Senior Software Engineer who wants direct product impact, Nova Product gives you the opportunity to own high-stakes customer workflows end to end. The team builds domain-specific workflows on top of our money-movement and identity systems, including distributions, capital calls, digital subscriptions, data rooms, and the emerging LP wallet and investor portal. You'll take difficult workflows from an ambiguous problem through launch and operation. The team will rely on you to get the details right because one incorrect number or failed payment can erode customer trust.

What You'll Do

Design, build, and ship complex workflows for distributions and capital calls, subscriptions, data rooms, and the LP wallet and portal. You'll own meaningful parts of this work end to end.
Take difficult problems from design through release and operation. You'll handle the edge cases and the long tail, not just the initial launch.
Build for correctness, resilience, and strong UX where real money and investor trust are at stake. Help catch predictable failures before they reach customers.
Model complex business domains and build maintainable systems and abstractions that your teammates can extend.
Improve the team's work through thoughtful code reviews and design feedback, and mentor other engineers.
Work with Product/Design and the Foundations teams to integrate product features cleanly with their money-movement and identity systems.

What We're Looking For

3+ years building backend or full-stack web applications, including meaningful experience with complex, quality-critical products where correctness matters to users.
Senior-level impact. You've owned significant features or systems from an ambiguous problem through launch and operation, and your team relies on you to get difficult work right in your area.
A record of shipping sophisticated product surfaces and improving their reliability and quality.
Strong architecture and data-modeling skills. You can model complex, evolving business domains and keep systems maintainable as they grow.
Fluency in a modern TypeScript stack, or clear evidence that you'll ramp quickly. You're comfortable with a GraphQL API, PostgreSQL, and workflow orchestration with Temporal.
Comfort working in a startup environment. You can handle ambiguity and maintain quality while keeping pace with a lean team that ships quickly.

Nice to Have

Experience in fintech, payments, or another high-stakes domain where correctness and trust are non-negotiable.
A record of taking greenfield product areas from zero to one and scaling mature ones.
Familiarity with event-driven architectures and workflow orchestration, such as Temporal or a similar system.
Experience working with platform or infrastructure teams whose systems your product depends on.

How Success Will Be Measured

The workflows you own across distributions, subscriptions, and capital calls are consistently error-free and increasingly self-service. For example, your work contributes to 95%+ of distributions completing end to end without manual intervention.
You ship meaningful parts of Nova's greenfield payments, wallet, and identity surfaces on a clear, coherent architecture that the team can extend.
Your parts of the product integrate cleanly with Foundations' systems and remain maintainable as they scale.
Your reviews, designs, and mentorship help other engineers make better technical decisions and move faster.

Working Here

If you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We value complementary strengths and operators who learn by doing.

We’re building our engineering and product teams around this hub to make the most of in-person collaboration. We have a hybrid in-office model: teammates come in at least 2 days per week (Tuesdays and either Wednesday or Thursday).
